$comment: Snapshot of the skills available to the workspace of Pol4720.
Re-captured 2026-09-03 from the live account (ListSkills) and from this repository.
Three kinds are recorded separately, because they are portable in different ways:
owned:   authored by Pol4720. Their source lives in this repository under skills/
and can be installed anywhere with scripts/install_skills.sh. Installing
them into ~/.claude/skills or <project>/.claude/skills makes them available
to Claude Code; that is INDEPENDENT of whether they are also uploaded to
claude.ai, which is a separate, manual step.
builtin: provided by Anthropic, enabled per account at claude.ai > Settings >
Capabilities. Not vendored here — the source is Anthropic's.
harness: shipped with the Claude Code harness. Nothing to enable.
captured_with: ListSkills + scripts/validate_skills.py, from a live Claude Code session

owned.name: repo-audit-fixer
owned.summary: Audits an entire repository as a hostile QA engineer, security reviewer and staff engineer, fixes everything found, proves each fix, and delivers a LaTeX audit report into Reports/audit-<timestamp>/.
owned.note: Loads as a project skill from .claude/skills/. To have it on claude.ai as well, zip the directory and upload it under Settings > Capabilities.

owned.name: thesis-auditor-fixer
owned.summary: Rigorous review and correction of CS/Software Engineering theses in LaTeX — produces exact corrections, not just diagnoses.
owned.note: Same as above: project skill here, not yet uploaded to claude.ai.

owned.name: q1-paper-auditor
owned.summary: Audits a scientific paper as a demanding Q1 referee, verifies every number against the data and code, repairs LaTeX to zero warnings, and writes an audit report plus a response letter.
owned.note: The only owned skill also enabled on claude.ai. When both copies exist, a session resolves the name once — the account copy wins, so keep the uploaded version in step with this repository.

harness_available_in_claude_code.$comment: Shipped with the Claude Code harness rather than enabled per account. Listed so the workspace can be described completely. repo-audit-fixer leans on run, code-review, security-review, dataviz and pdf by name.
